column2: Diagrams: how do I make a Lexis diagram, a ternary diagram, candlesticks, a curve with a margin or a horizon chart?
column3: New diagram: “📐 Lexis diagram” (Life and death: years at the bottom, ages on the left, each life as a diagonal, with marriages, children, departures and historical bands), “🔺 Ternary diagram” (Parts: three parts adding up to 100%, for example occupational sectors by municipality, decade or family) and “🕯 Candlesticks” (Figures: wheat price, open, close, low, high, moving average). Others are settings: Curve → “Range” (low and high columns, or “🌳 Data from my tree” → Average and margin); Stacked hills → Shape “Horizon”; Leeds matrix → “Clustering tree on the left”; Parents’ ages → “Only the paternal (or maternal) line”; What you have proved → “One row per ancestor”; Places of residence timeline → “What is followed: marital status” and Axis “Age”; Occupations from father to son → “The same people at several ages”. In “From the app”, choose the group, “＋ Criterion” and the period; everything taken stays editable in the Data tab (rows, values, colours), by hand or by pasting a table.
